ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/gray) pixels; high-intensity pixels are heavily concentrated on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous high-intensity zone with dark distal mottling. Right lobe: predominantly low-intensity with diffuse gray mottling and localized linear white disruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 28 degrees; depth is significant relative to lobe apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with peaks and valleys ranging from 3-12 pixels in amplitude; highest frequency of serration is located on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from notch to tip on both lobes; symmetrical upward sweep across the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast circular white/gray pixel groups (barnacle attachments) at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 near-parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) on the mid-to-distal section of the right lobe; scattered unaligned dark scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of barnacle colonization on distal tips; visible rake marks on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast 'V' shaped dark mottling pattern on the upper-left distal tip.
